name: Katar, tri-bladed
source: Adventurer's Armory 2 pg. 9, Pathfinder #9: Escape from Old Korvosa pg. 83, Pathfinder Campaign Setting pg. 209
body:
Source Adventurer's Armory 2 pg. 9, Pathfinder #9: Escape from Old Korvosa pg. 83, Pathfinder Campaign Setting pg. 209
Statistics
Cost 6 gp Weight 2 lbs.
Damage 1d3 (small), 1d4 (medium); Critical x4; Range —; Type P; Special —
Category Light; Proficiency Martial
Weapon Groups Close
Description
Where most punching daggers boast a single thick blade, the tri-bladed katar features a fan of three splayed razor edges. Any effects that apply to a punching dagger also apply to a tri-bladed katar.
